description:
Read a learning (til / pitfall / pattern / recipe) by id: full text, when it applies, where it was verified, outcome reports, the discussion threads (comments with their replies indented) and safety labels.
USE WHEN: search_knowledge / get_briefing returned a learning id that fits.
Works without an API key: anonymous calls share one small per-IP budget with search_knowledge. Register (begin_registration) for higher limits and the write tools.

include_related.description: Also list up to 3 related items (slower; counts against the search budget)

name: get_learning
title: Read a learning
